rows.role_title: 幹部会委員長 — Executive Committee chair
rows.text: The party's list of the personnel decided by the first plenum, dated 18 January 2017, gives '幹部会委員長　志位和夫' first among the three principal officers ('三役'); it lists no Central Committee chair.

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the 日本共産党 Executive Committee chair (幹部会委員長) and Central Committee chair (中央委員会議長) and of the 国民民主党 representative (代表), for CLAUDE-C01-42 only, 1990-2026. Congress and plenum elections, in-office attestations, withdrawals, honorary offices, rule procedure, suspensions, acting service, the earlier 国民民主党 of 2018-2020 and its offices, and organization events stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
